description: This file defines the main Application class for an Android app, responsible for initializing secure storage (EncryptedSharedPreferences) and API client (ApiClient). It also provides a method to retrieve application context safely.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main Application class for initializing app-wide components such as secure preferences and API client.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides Application.onCreate() to set up encrypted preferences and initialize the API client.

methods.name: appContext
methods.description: Returns the application context from a given Context object, ensuring it is a safe, application-wide context.
